faq.title: Will my client ever know you exist?

acf.answer: Not from us. Staging domains, commit messages, documents and reports carry your brand. We never contact your client, and we do not list your projects anywhere without your written permission.

faq.title: Where is the team, and what hours do you cover?

acf.answer: Dhaka, Bangladesh (UTC+6, no daylight saving). That gives a full morning overlap with the UK and Europe and an early-morning overlap with the US East Coast. A brief sent at the end of your day is usually in review by your next morning.

Project work is a fixed price against a written scope. Ongoing work runs on a monthly retainer sized in hours. You get a scope and quote within two business days of a brief, and nothing starts until you approve it.

faq.title: What do you need from us to start?

acf.answer: Whatever you have: a Figma file, a live URL, a client email, an SEO audit, an ads account structure. We will ask the missing questions in the scoping call rather than guess.

Through a shared password-manager vault with least-privilege access — a scoped WordPress role, Shopify staff permissions or GA4 property access rather than owner logins. Access is revoked at handover and confirmed in writing.

faq.title: Can you sign our NDA and contractor agreement?

acf.answer: Yes. We can work under your paperwork or provide a mutual NDA before you share any client details. For EU and UK client data we work under Standard Contractual Clauses or the UK IDTA and a data processing agreement.

faq.title: What if a project does not fit a plan?

acf.answer: Tell us in the brief. Anything outside a plan — a one-off build, a migration, a rescue — is scoped and quoted separately, with a written scope and a fixed price before any work starts.

faq.title: What counts as an active project?

acf.answer: One client website in production at a time. You can send as many briefs as you like; the plan limits how many run in parallel, not how many you queue.
Say so in the brief. If we can hit the date we will tell you what it costs; if we cannot, we will tell you that instead of taking the work and missing it.

faq.title: Do you mark up third-party costs?

acf.answer: No. Hosting, plugins, ad spend and tools are billed at cost or held in your accounts. We quote our work; everything else is transparent.

acf.detail: Our template or yours, signed before you share a client's name.
No emails, no LinkedIn, no portfolio use without your written permission.

promise.title: A named producer on every project

acf.detail: One person owns your project and answers in your shared channel.
The quote is the price. Scope changes are written down before they are built.

promise.title: Post-launch defects fixed at our cost

acf.detail: If it was in the scope and it breaks, we fix it. No invoice.

acf.body: We will not approach, market to, quote for or accept work from your client — during the project or after it.
No footer links, no watermarks, no 'built by' anywhere. Commit messages, staging domains and documents carry your brand.
Mutual NDA on request before the brief. Credentials live in a shared vault, never in email, and are revoked and confirmed at handover.
Strategy, communication, billing and the commercial relationship are yours. We handle production and execution.
Bangladesh is not on the EU adequacy list, so we work under Standard Contractual Clauses, the UK IDTA and an Article 28 data processing agreement.
